description: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/compare/{base}...{head}: how `head` differs from `base` (`status`, `ahead_by`, `behind_by`), one page of the commits between them, and the files changed with their patches. Pass `base` and `head` as separate arguments, not GitHub REST's single `basehead` path parameter. Both are branches, tags, or SHAs; `head` may be `owner:branch` for a fork.

base.description: Base branch, tag, or commit SHA.

head.description: Head branch, tag, or commit SHA.

per_page.description: Results per page (GitHub's default is 30, max 100).
